# gitlab_compliance_framework_templates (Data Source)

The `gitlab_compliance_framework_templates` data source allows details of the GitLab compliance framework templates to be retrieved given some optional filter criteria.

**Upstream API**: [GitLab GraphQL API docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/graphql/reference/#querycomplianceframeworktemplates)

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitlab_compliance_framework_templates" "all" {
}

data "gitlab_compliance_framework_templates" "example_by_template_id" {
  template_id = "gid://gitlab/ComplianceManagement::Frameworks::TemplateRegistry::Template/soc2"
}

data "gitlab_compliance_framework_templates" "example_by_name" {
  name = "NIST 800-171 Rev. 3 CMMC"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Get the compliance framework template with the specific name.
- `template_id` (String) Filter by template ID. In the format of: `gid://gitlab/ComplianceManagement::Frameworks::TemplateRegistry::Template/<template id>`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this datasource. In the format of a hash taken from the search options.
- `templates` (Attributes List) List of compliance framework templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `color` (String) Hexadecimal representation of the template’s label color. e.g. #FCA121.
- `description` (String) Description of the compliance framework template.
- `id` (String) ID of the compliance framework template.
- `json` (String) Full JSON representation of the compliance framework template.
- `name` (String) Name of the compliance framework template.
- `template_version` (Number) Version of the template.
